title: Dinesh Keswani Joins Goldman Sachs as Partner and Co-Head of The Core Engineering
body_markdown:
**New York, September 3, 2026 –** The Goldman Sachs Group, Inc. (NYSE: GS) today announced that Dinesh Keswani has joined the firm as a Partner and co-head of The Core Engineering alongside Gopi Parameswaran. Dinesh will also serve as chief technology officer of The Core Engineering.


In this role, he will work with teams across The Core to drive sustained innovation, apply consistent practices, governance, and processes, and achieve scaled engineering solutions for the entire organization. The Core is comprised of the firm’s functional areas that enable business activity by providing the framework, oversight, and foundational processes allowing Goldman Sachs to scale and operate effectively.


Dinesh brings considerable engineering leadership experience and technical expertise to the firm, having worked at several financial services and technology institutions over the course of his career. He most recently served as chief technology and operations officer at Nomura Group. Prior to that, Dinesh was chief technology officer and Retail Banking digital chief information officer at HSBC. Earlier in his career, he held leadership roles at GoDaddy and Microsoft.


Dinesh started his career at Verizon after earning an MBA from Maharishi International University and a Bachelor of Science in Mathematics from University of Madras.


###


Goldman Sachs is a leading global financial institution that delivers a broad range of financial services to a large and diversified client base that includes corporations, financial institutions, governments and individuals. Founded in 1869, the firm is headquartered in New York and maintains offices in all major financial centers around the world.
